# QuoteGauge

> QuoteGauge is a web tool that checks whether a car repair quote is fair. A driver adds a mechanic's quote (photo or typed lines) with the vehicle's year, make and model, a US ZIP code and the type of shop. QuoteGauge estimates a fair price range for every line and marks each one fair, above market or needs verification.

## Key facts

- What it does: estimates fair price ranges for car repair and maintenance quotes in the United States.
- Inputs: the quote, vehicle year/make/model, ZIP code, and whether the shop is independent, a dealership or a national chain.
- Output: an overall verdict, the likely overcharge in dollars, a rating for each line, items that may not be needed, and a script for talking to the shop.
- Products and prices: Repair Quote Checker ($4.99) prices one estimate line by line; Repair Quote Comparator ($14.99) compares up to five estimates for the same repair and recommends the best value; Repair Necessity Checker ($9.99) explains recommended repairs and sorts them by urgency. The first answer on each is free. Purchases are one-time, with no subscription and no account.
- Method: AI estimates built from standard labor times, typical parts cost and typical regional labor rates for the type of shop.
- Rating rule: a line is "above market" when it is more than 10% over the top of its fair range, and "needs verification" when it cannot be judged without seeing the car.
- Limits: it is an estimate, not an inspection. It cannot see the car's condition or the grade of parts quoted. It does not cover collision or body work.
- Independence: QuoteGauge takes no referral fees or commissions from repair shops, dealerships or parts sellers.
- Privacy: quotes are analysed and not stored by QuoteGauge after the report is produced.
